Alpine Foxling "Burrows deep into snowbanks to hide from predators." Pet Battle Kun-Lai Summit --
Alpine Foxling Kit "Occasionally sneaks bites of food from kills made by much larger animals." Pet Battle Kun-Lai Summit --
Amber Moth "Known to flourish in the rainy season, this insect is drawn to lightning storms." Pet Battle Dread Wastes, Townlong Steppes --
Amber Primordial Direhorn There is an old Zandalari saying about wild direhorns: "Run!" Zandalari Warbringer Dread Wastes, Kun-Lai Summit, Townlong Steppes, Valley of the Four Winds --
Amberglow Stinger "The glow emanating from these is both calming and eerie at the same time when in total darkness." Drop: Blade Lord Ta'yak Heart of Fear --
Amethyst Spiderling "A rarity among arachnids, these non-venomous critters feed solely on plants and fruit." Pet Battle Krasarang Wilds --
Aqua Strider "Water striders serve an important role in jinyu culture, acting as a mount, means of sending communications, and even a family pet." Drop: Nalash Verdantis Dread Wastes --
Ashleaf Spriteling "The Ashleaf Sprites of the Timeless Isle tirelessly protect the vegetation of the island from the burning fury of Ordos and his minions." Drop: Leafmender Timeless Isle --
Ashwing Moth "Jinyu assassins employ this moth as both a portable decoy and a light source to reveal weak spots in their enemy's armor." Pet Battle Timeless Isle --
Azure Crane Chick "Crane chicks of the Timeless Isle sometimes sing a curious song that calms the nerves and soothes the soul." Drop: Crane Nest Timeless Isle --
Azure Windseeker "This little cloud serpent's favorite activity is chasing its own tail." Drop: Tsulong Terrace of Endless Spring --
Bandicoon "The taciturn bandicoon's diet consists mostly of apples." Pet Battle Valley of the Four Winds --
Bandicoon Kit "Some druids say pandaren and raccoons are distant cousins, but never when a pandaren can hear them." Pet Battle Valley of the Four Winds --
Baoh-Xi "For being an inanimate object for many centuries, this statue sure moves around really well." Drop: Qin-xi Mogu-shan Vaults --

Bonkers "Some young and rambunctious hozen are trained from an early age to use boxing gloves so they don't accidentally kill their tribe members, and more importantly, to keep them from picking their noses." Drop: Kukuru Chest Timeless Isle --
Bucktooth Flapper "It's hard to know what's more dangerous: the teeth or the tail." Pet Battle The Jade Forest --
Chi-Chi, Hatchling of Chi-Ji "Chi-Chi tries to inspire hope with her loud squawk and by chasing and eventually eating, butterflies." Vendor: Master Li Timeless Isle 3 Celestial Coins
Chi-Ji Kite "A beautiful kite brought to life by the scribes of Pandaria." Profession: Mists of Pandaria Inscription -- --
Clouded Hedgehog "Hedgehogs are not all fond of croquet nor flamingos." Pet Battles Dread Wastes --
Comet "The Engine of Nalak' sha is defended by many mighty beings, and many tiny beings." Drop: Elegon Mogu' shan Vaults --
Coral Adder "The coral adder's venom is so deadly that one bite has been known to kill a full grown kodo beast." Pet Battle The Jade Forest --
Crunchy Scorpion "Unique carapace is prized by trinket makers for its texture and strength." Pet Battle Dread Wastes --

Dancing Water Skimmer "Named for their apparent dancelike behavior when skimming aquatic surfaces, the species uses erratic movements to avoid being devoured by fish and other underwater predators." Pet Battle Vale of Eternal Blossoms --
Dandelion Frolicker "While fascinated by flowers, the frolicker has also been known to dance with blades of grass and the occasional weed." Drop: Scary Sprite Timeless Isle --

Death Adder Hatchling "Late in life, if the environmental conditions are correct, a Death Adder may shed its skin and undergo a transformation into an Imperial Python." Drop: Imperial Python Timeless Isle --
Direhorn Runt "The Zandalari breed specific Direhorn species for their small size for use as mounts." Drop: Direhorns Isle of Giants --
Effervescent Glowfly "Luminescent body used to attract mates." Pet Battle Vale of Eternal Blossoms --
Elder Python "These snakes have been known to swallow gnomes in one gulp." Pet Battle Isle of Thunder --
Electrified Razortooth "Lightning can be seen flowing across its body, teeth to tail." Pet Battle Isle of Thunder --
Emerald Turtle "It is difficult to believe that Shen-zin Su, on whose shell rests all of the Wandering Isle, began life as a tiny emerald turtle." Pet Battle Jade Forest --

Emperor Crab "The emperor crab was named for its regal appearance: the ridges of its shell and its raised claws eerily resembling the crown. One that would pinch your eyes out if you tried to wear it." Pet Battle Dread Wastes --
Eternal Strider "It seems like a trick to the eyes, but the eternal strider can walk across water, its small feet never breaking the surface." Pet Battle Vale of Eternal Blossoms --
Feverbite Hatchling "The common folk remedy to a feverbite hatchling's bite is to dance wildly and try to sweat out the toxins before they can take hold." Pet Battle Krasarang Wilds --
Filthling "Battle pet trainers are strongly encouraged to wash their hands for at least 30 minutes after playing with the filthling." Drop: Quivering Filth Isle of Thunder --

Fishy "Many believe (incorrectly) that goldfish have no memories. Trainers who have worked with them know this is clearly not the case and have the bruises to prove it." Quest: Let Them Burn The Jade Forest --
Flamering Moth "Cats and other curious critters often have short-lived play sessions with this moth that end with a face full of singed hair." Pet Battle Timeless Isle --
Garden Frog "One of the stranger nuisances to horticulturalists, garden frogs can cause untold damage to gardens." Pet Battle Azsuna, Highmountain, The Jade Forest --
Garden Moth "Known to flourish in the rainy season, this insect is drawn to lightning storms." Pet Battle Jade Forest --
Gilded Moth "This delicate insect's wings are often sewn into clothing and armor." Pet Battle Vale of Eternal Blossoms --
Golden Civet "Civets are landbound cousins of the otter and are prized for their heady musks." Pet Battle Vale of Eternal Blossoms --
Golden Civet Kitten "The civets are known to guard their young ferociously." Pet Battle Vale of Eternal Blossoms --

Gooey Sha-ling "Sha-lings reflect the emotional state of their handler, becoming agitated, depressed, fearful, or doubtful depending on the magnitude of negative thoughts around them." Drop: Sha of Pride Siege of Orgrimmar --

Grassland Hopper "At night, the grassland hoppers fill the night with their maddening song. Those unaccustomed to it have spent many a sleepless night serenaded by their mating calls." Pet Battle Townlong Steppes --
Grinder "Mogu sorcerers, keepers of the secret to bringing stone to life, prefer these stolid companions over more beastly familiars." Drop: Karr the Darkener Dread Wastes --
Grove Viper "The Jade Forest's mountain hozen fear these venomous reptiles and often hunt them out of pure spite." Pet Battle The Jade Forest --
Gu'chi Swarmling "Swarmlings of Gu'chi spin an ancient, and very powerful, form of silk that has not been seen in Pandaria in ages." Drop: Gu'chi the Swarmbringer Timeless Isle --
Gulp Froglet "Gulp frogs of the Timeless Isle can feast upon prey several times larger than themselves by slowly digesting the victim externally with a toxic slime." Drop: Bufo Timeless Isle --

Harmonious Porcupette "Prolonged exposure to Shaohao's tranquil mists has calmed these sprites, which act as peaceful companions to the Mistweavers." Vendor: Mistweaver Ku Timeless Isle Faction: Shaohao – Revered 7,500 Timeless Coins
Hopling "The great big world can be a dangerous place for such a tiny, adorable creature." Achievement: Ling-Ting's Herbal Journey Stormstout Brewery --
Imperial Moth "The larval form of this moth is world-renowned for creating the finest silk in Azeroth." Profession: Mists of Pandaria Tailoring (Imperial Silk) -- --
Infinite Hatchling "The infinite dragonflight is far more diverse than most denizens of Azeroth know." Vendor: Mistweaver Xia Timeless Isle 2,200 Timewarped Badges
Jade Crane Chick "A graceful creature from the isle of Pandaria." Vendor: Audrey Burnhep, Varzok Stormwind, Orgrimmar 50 Silver

Jade Owl "Jade is naturally rich with life and color, making it the perfect raw material for this gentle companion. It is said the wind created by their wings can soothe the troubled mind." Profession: Mists of Pandaria Jewelcrafting -- --
Jadefire Spirit "The Jadefire Spirit is thought to be a living embodiment of Yu'lon's own jade breath." Drop: Spirit of Jadefire Timeless Isle --
Jademist Dancer "The Jademist Dancers of the Timeless Isle have a curious attraction to the steam vents of the northwestern shore." Drop: Jademist Dancer Timeless Isle --
Ji-Kun Hatchling "Deadly offspring of the Ancient Mother, Ji-Kun hatchlings are considered sacred treasures in many cultures." Drop: Ji-Kun Throne of Thunder --
Jumping Spider "This terrifying and highly venomous species leaps onto its prey from the Jade Forest's dense canopy." Pet Battle The Jade Forest --
Jungle Darter "In the jungle, every leaf could conceal a frog. Stop to check and it could be long gone." Pet Battle Jade Forest --
Jungle Grub "These little green grubs are native to wilds of Pandaria. Its verdant coloration camouflages it from would-be predators." Pet Battle Krasarang Wilds --
Kor'thik Swarmling "Don't let these eat after midnight, legend has it that it's very dangerous." Drop: Imperial Vizier Zor' lok Heart of Fear --

Kovok "The tiny terror of the Dread Wastes, Kovok prefers a steady diet of "brain food:" mushan brains, human brains, any brains really." This strange nutritional requirement may be tangentially related to his enormous head." Drop: Paragons of the Klaxxi Siege of Orgrimmar --
Kuitan Mongoose "The mongoose is prized for its ability to drive off poisonous snakes. Rikk-tikk-tikki-tikki-tchk!" Pet Battle Townlong Steppes --
Kun-Lai Runt "Indigenous to the peaks of Kun-Lai Summit, this rare yeti is much more dangerous than it looks." Pet Battle Kun-Lai Summit
Leopard Tree Frog "The leopard tree frog was named for the way it pounces from branch to branch." Pet Battle Gorgrond, The Jade Forest --
Living Amber "The mantid are extremely reliant upon amber for many things, and even use it in some of their magic." Drop: Amber-Shaper Un-sok Heart of Fear --
Living Fluid "The dark pools in Primordius chamber laid stagnant after the fall of the mogu, and murky thoughts began to coalesce." Drop: Primordius Throne of Thunder --
Living Sandling "Born of sand, these dangerous creatures can form and disperse in the blink of an eye." Drop: Throne of Thunder Throne of Thunder --
Luyu Moth "A daring, narcissist insect willing to brave any threat in its pursuit of the spotlight." Pet Battle Krasarang Wilds --
Malayan Quillrat "Many believe that the quillrat is able to shoot its spines at aggressors." Pet Battle Valley of the Four Winds, Krasarang Wilds --
Malayan Quillrat Pup "Although the wounds caused by the young quillrat are seldom fatal, most predators seek easier prey." Pet Battle Valley of the Four Winds --
Marsh Fiddler "Known to feast on the tasty plants in valley of the Four Winds." Pet Battle Valley of the Four Winds --
Masked Tanuki "There's a raging debate over whether tanukis are raccoons or dogs, but the distinction seems trivial when they're gnawing on your femur." Pet Battle The Jade Forest --
Masked Tanuki Pup "Many young raccoons rail against their strict curfews, complaining that dawn is way too early to go to bed." Pet Battle The Jade Forest --

Mechanical Pandaren Dragonling "Constructed from a seemingly impossible mass of gears, springs, wires, and a little something special, this dragonling embodies the spirit of Pandaria as seen through an engineer's goggles." Profession: Mists of Pandaria Engineering -- --
Mei Li Sparkler "Feeds on small leaves and grass when full grown." Pet Battle Krasarang Wilds --
Mirror Strider "When preparing to travel to distant locations, Pandaren will traditionally capture a mirror strider and safely relocate it to another body of water." Pet Battle The Jade Forest --

Mongoose "Contrary to its benign appearance, mongoose are dangerous carnivores, well known for their ability to hunt venomous snakes that could kill much larger creatures." Pet Battle Townlong Steppes --
Mongoose Pup "Mongoose pups prefer long grass where only their mothers can find them." Pet Battle Townlong Steppes --
Mountain Panda "Cousin to Snowy Panda, Mountain Panda reside in the lower regions of Kun-Lai Summit." Quest: Beasts of Fable -- --
Ominous Flame "The odd blue flames found within the Cavern of Lost Spirits have led many unwary adventurers to their doom." Drop: Foreboding Flame Timeless Isle --
Pandaren Air Spirit "These spirits represent the heart of Pandaria's elemental powers." Quest: Pandaren Spirit Tamer Vale of Eternal Blossoms --
Pandaren Earth Spirit "The elements of Pandaria can be cute and playful, until their homeland is threatened." Quest: Pandaren Spirit Tamer Vale of Eternal Blossoms --
Pandaren Fire Spirit "Though it appears to be a vaguely-related cousin to the Cinder Kitten, the two creatures actually share no ancestry." Quest: Pandaren Spirit Tamer Vale of Eternal Blossoms --
Pandaren Water Spirit "Water spirits are especially mischievous and are known to frequent the canals of the Stormstout Brewery." Quest: Pandaren Spirit Tamer Vale of Eternal Blossoms --
Paradox Spirit "It is a riddle wrapped in a mystery inside an enigma." Vendor: Mistweaver Xia Timeless Isle 2,200 Timewarped Badges

Pierre "Every cook's dream wrapped up in a perfect bundle of metal and bolts. Too bad what he cooks up isn't suitable for humanoid consumption. According to Jard's notes, he intends to make this little guy for his friend, Emily Cole." Profession: Mists of Pandaria Engineering -- --

Plains Monitor "While stationary, the plains monitor will continuously flick its tail back and forth. From a distance this mimics the appearance of swaying tailgrass, camouflaging the lizard from aerial predators. Pet Battle Kun-Lau Summit --
Prairie Mouse "On the prairie there are numerous rodents and other small creatures, but none more common than the mouse." Pet Battle Kun-Lau Summit --
Pygmy Direhorn "Don't pet the pointy end. Note: all of the ends are pointy." Drop: Horridon Throne of Thunder --
Rapana Whelk "Has been spotted fighting other whelks for prime food sources." Pet Battle Dread Wastes --

Rascal-Bot "This little guy seems to like to hang out at the fringes of cataclysmic events. There is no evidence to suggest he has anything to do with the cause of these events, though — he's probably just an observer. Or maybe he just gets lost on his trek to other places." Profession: Mists of Pandaria Engineering -- --
Ravenous Prideling "As a spawn of the most dangerous sha, this little monster has some big plans, but needs to wait a few thousand years first." Drop: Grand Empress Shek'zeer Heart of Fear --
Red Cricket "Be careful, he might eat all your crops!" Quest: Sho, Requires Exalted Friendship Faction Valley of the Four Winds --
Red Panda "Can you believe how cute I am? Me neither." Quest: Beasts of Fable -- --
Resilient Roach "The roaches of the Dread Wastes dwell in the shadows. Some people swear the shadows travel with them." Pet Battle Dread Wastes --
Ruby Droplet "The waters of Ruby Lake are colored a strange reddish hue, possibly due to the ruby crystals found deep within the mountains of the Timeless Isle." Drop: Garnia Timeless Isle --
Sandy Petrel "The sandy petrel flies high above the Windless Isle, safe from landbound predators." Pet Battle Jade Forest --

Sapphire Cub "While each cub is crafted in the same fashion, tiny imperfections in the gemstones create a unique personality when imbued with life. They are, however, always playful and friendly." Profession: Mists of Pandaria Jewelcrafting -- --
Savory Beetle "The most delicious of the beetle family." Pet Battle Krasarang Wilds --
Sea Gull "The seagull is a coastal scavenger often found near the docks." Pet Battle Frostwall, Krasarang Wilds, Talador, Tanaris --
Shrine Fly "This species of insect is drawn to the latent energy in shrines, their luminescent appearance adding to the mystique of the places of power." Pet Battle Jade Forest --
Shy Bandicoon "A goblin alchemist once claimed that the bite of this raccoon gave him the gift of prophecy. Turns out, it was just rabies." Pet Battle Valley of the Four Winds --
Sifang Otter "The sifang otter lives near rivers and is normally friendly and playful." Pet Battle Valley of the Four Winds --
Sifang Otter Pup "Otters swim by propelling themselves with their powerful tails and flexing their long bodies. Very fast in the water." Pet Battle Valley of the Four Winds --
Silent Hedgehog "These hedgehogs may be silent, but often are heard the cries of those that foolishly step upon their quills." Pet Battle Dread Wastes --
Silkbead Snail "Hides in shell to escape claws of nearby crabs." Pet Battle Gorgrond, Spires of Arak, Talador, The Jade Forest --

Skunky Alemental "When the village of Pi'jiu was attacked by the Ordon Yaungol generations ago, the villagers bravely erected a keg in the center of the village. The following morning, after the celebration had died down, the still-drunken Yaungol blearily agreed to a peace treaty." Drop: Zhu-Ghon the Sour Timeless Isle --
Sky Lantern "A candle inside of the kite heats the air, causing it to rise into the air without the need for wind." Vendor: Ku-Mo Timeless Isle --
Skywisp Moth "This curious moth is sometimes found interrupting the spells of a wandering mage or warlock." Pet Battle Timeless Isle --
Snowy Panda "The white fur of the Snowy Panda allows it to hide in the snowbanks of Kun-Lai Summit Quest: Beasts of Fable -- --
Softshell Snapling "Softshell turtle meat is considered a delicacy and is the key ingredient in soothing turtle bisque." Pet Battle: Valley of the Four Winds -- --
Son of Animus "Forged in the Throne of Thunder, these tiny creations are servants of the great Dark Animus." Drop: Animus Throne of Thunder --
Spawn of G'nathus "Some Pandaren believe G'nathus to be an ancient Zandalari Loa left behind to guard the waters south of Lei Shen's Island citadel." Drop: G'nathus Townlong Steppes --

Spawn of Garalon "The kunchong are extremely aggressive and will eat just about anything they can as soon as they care able to walk. If they can't eat it, they will smash it instead." Drop: Garalon Heart of Fear --
Spectral Porcupette "Something about this creature looks familiar…" Quest: A Large Pile of Giant Dinosaur Bones Isle of Giants --
Spineclaw Crab "Spineclaw crabs of Pandaria have existed for thousands of years and remain one of the continent's oldest creatures." Drop: Monstrous Spineclaw Timeless Isle --
Spiny Terrapin "Angering a spiny terrapin will cause it to withdraw into its shell and begin to spin wildly towards an attacker." Pet Battle Krasarang Wilds --
Spirebound Crab "These tiny arthropods are Pandaria natives that call the area of the Windless Isle their home." Pet Battle The Jade Forest --
Spirit of the Spring "The elemental spirits of Pandaria have been known to plan tricks to play on unsuspecting visitors years in advance." Drop: Lei Shi Terrace of Endless Spring --
Stoneclaw "Quilen were the favored companions of the ancient Mogu race due to their loyal nature." Drop: The Stone Guard Mogu' shan Vaults --
Summit Kid "You'll often find them perched high atop impossibly high and remote stone outcroppings. There are few creatures as sure of foot." Pet Battle Kun-Lai Summit --
Sumprush Rodent "A rodent of usual size." Pet Battle Krasarang Wilds --
Sunfur Panda "These cuddly rascals enjoy basking in the sun, sleeping in the sun, and napping in the sun." Quest: Beasts of Fable -- --
Sunreaver Micro-Sentry "Loyal to the Sunreavers from creation, these pint-sized constructs can still pack a punch." Drop: Haywire Sunreaver Construct Isle of Thunder --
Swamp Croaker "Probably best not to touch it." Pet Battle Isle of Thunder --
Szechuan Chicken "Will only lay eggs in bright light." Pet Battle Kun-Lai Summit --
Temple Snake "The Jade Forest's pandaren consider these reptiles distant relatives of the revered Jade Serpent, Yu'lon." Pet Battle The Jade Forest --
Terrible Turnip "And you thought turnips at the dinner table were bad." Drop: World Drop Valley of the Four Winds --
Thundertail Flapper "Touched by lightning, these dangerous rodents should be kept at a safe distance." Pet Battle Isle of Thunder --

Tiny Blue Carp "These little guys can be found in the waters of the Timeless Isle, or swimming alongside Jewel Danio or Redbelly Mandarin. Dedicated fishermen can sometimes befriend one." Profession: Mists of Pandaria Fishing -- --
Tiny Goldfish "This bubble is way worse than a tank." Vendor: Nat Pagle Krasarang Wilds Faction: The Anglers – Honored 250 Gold

Tiny Green Carp "It is believed that the green coloration and stripes on the tiny green carp serve as camouflage in the waters of the Jade Forest, Valley of the Four Winds and the Krasarang Wilds. Dedicated fishermen can sometimes befriend one." Profession: Mists of Pandaria Fishing -- --

Tiny Red Carp "The red scales on these fish are believed to be a warning to predators of the Townlong Steppes and the Dread Wastes that their flesh is toxic. Dedicated fishermen can sometimes befriend one." Profession: Mists of Pandaria Fishing -- --

Tiny White Carp "These hardy fish can survive in a wide range of climates, from the snow-capped mountains of Kun-Lai Summit to the temperate, salty waters of the oceans around Pandaria. Dedicated fishermen can sometimes befriend one too." Profession: Mists of Pandaria Fishing -- --

Tolai Hare "In the ancient fables, the first Tolai hare strode across the gulf between the stars before it upset them and they tumbled from the heavens to the world below." Pet Battle Kun-Lai Summit --
Tolai Hare Pup "Tolai hare pups are sent from their dens at a young age to find their own way." Pet Battle Kun-Lai Summit --

Vengeful Porcupette "One of the beasts left on the Timeless Isle when it shifted through time, most likely sacrificed by the Ordon to their demigod, Ordos." Vendor: Speaker Gulan Timeless Isle 100 Bloody Coins
Viscous Horror "These malicious oozes are highly sensitive to Primordious' pheromone signature." Drop: Primordious Throne of Thunder Normal or Heroic Difficulty
Wayward Spirit "Crossing into the spirit world too often can be dangerous for your health." Drop: Gara'jal the Spiritbinder Mogu' shan Vaults --
Wild Crimson Hatchling "It's red, so it must fly faster." Pet Battle The Jade Forest Faction: Order of the Cloud Serpent - Exalted

Wild Golden Hatchling "The offspring of Tsulong, hidden away before the corruption of the Sha had fully taken hold of the Terrace of Endless Spring." Pet Battle The Jade Forest Faction: Order of the Cloud Serpent - Exalted
Wild Jade Hatchling "So cute, yet so epic." Pet Battle The Jade Forest Faction: Order of the Cloud Serpent - Exalted

Xu-Fu, Cub of Xuen "Fierce and loyal, Xu-Fu loves to hunt by moonlight. Once during a full moon, he killed and ate an entire Ironfur Great Bull, prompting a two-day nap." Vendor: Tournament of Celestials Timeless Isle --
Yakrat "The bond between yak and rat is a strange one, and what the rat gains out of the symbiotic relationship is a mystery." Pet Battle Townlong Steppes, Dread Wastes --
Yellow-Bellied Bullfrog "Despite its menacing appearance, the yellow-bellied bullfrog was aptly named." Pet Battle Vale of Eternal Blossoms --

Yu'la, Broodling of Yu'lon "A master sculptor devoted her life to creating an incomparably beautiful statue, inspired by her love and reverence for Yu'lon. When the sculptor passed away, Yu'lon breathed a fraction of her essence into the statue, bringing Yu'la into the world." Vendor: Master Li Timeless Isle 3 Celestial Coins
Yu'lon Kite "Who knew scribes could make kites?" Profession: Mists of Pandaria Inscription -- --
Zandalari Anklerender "These tiny minions of Zandalar are adept at stowing away within the cargo holds of the enormous Zandalari warships." Drop: Zandalari Dinomancer Isle of Giants --
Zandalari Footslasher "Even at this size, these raptors can eviscerate an entire cow in less than 10 seconds." Drop: Zandalari Dinomancer Isle of Giants --
Zandalari Kneebiter "This unique raptor was born on the island of Zandalar and transported here along with the rest of the Zandalari army." Drop: Zandalari Dinomancer Isle of Giants --
Zandalari Toenibbler "These adorable beasts are both cuddly and huggable, providing you do not enjoy having a face." Drop: Zandalari Dinomancer Isle of Giants --
Zao, Calfling of Niuzao "Always on the lookout for a fight or some tasty grass, Zao keeps his head down and eyes forward." Vendor: Tournament of Celestials Timeless Isle --
Zooey Snake "These reptiles possess hooked scales, allowing them to slither up Kun-Lai Summit's rocky slopes and steep cliffs." Pet Battle Kun-Lai Summit --
Adopted Puppy Crate Release your adopted puppies for 10 minutes of fun. "All they needed was someone to play with them." Vendor: Mistweaver Xia Timeless Isle 1,000 Timewalking Badges
Ai'Li's Skymirror Take on the slightly shimmery appearance of the target for 10 minutes. "Rimmed with an ever-shifting ring of clouds." Drop: Ai'Li Skymirror Dread Wastes --

Anatomical Dummy Summon an Anatomical Dummy at target location for 5 minutes. The punching bag acts as a target dummy while it persists. Only usable outdoors in Pandaria. "Artifact details have already been logged in your Archaeology Journal, under the Completed Artifacts tab." Archaeology -- Mogu Archaeology Fragments
Anglers Fishing Raft You can raft across water. "Great for fishing but takes on water…so don't stay out too long!" Profession: Fishing Krasarang Wilds Faction: The Anglers- Revered and 525 Fishing
Aqua Jewel Increases swim speed by 50% and allows underwater breathing for 10 minutes. Only usable on Pandaria. Drop: Sahn Tidehunter Vale of Eternal Blossoms --

Ash-Covered Horn Summons a ridable but uncontrollable Furious Ashhide Mushan. This is a very, VERY fast mount. Can only be used on the Timeless Isle. "Perpetually warm to the touch." Drop: High Priest of Ordos Timeless Isle --
B.F.F. Necklace Offer the necklace. Drop: Huggalon the Heart Watcher Townlong Steppes --

Battle Horn Blast a blaring horn, attracting enemies within 40 yards. Ineffective on targets above level 100 or not native to Pandaria. "Carried by Yaungol scouts to alert allies to impending attacks." Drop: Blackhoof/Ordon Candlekeeper Valley of the Four Winds/Timeless Isle --
Blackflame Daggers Wear the Blackflame Daggers, signifying your allegiance to Ordos. "Ceremonial daggers used by champions of Ordos. Drop: Champion of the Black Flame Timeless Isle --

Bottled Tornado Jump high into the sky on the winds of Pandaria. Can only be used outdoors. "The Mantid learned long ago how to bend the winds of Pandaria to the Empress' will." Drop: Kal' tik the Blight Vale of Eternal Blossoms --
Celestial Defender's Medallion Take on the guise of a Celestial Defender. Vendor: Mistweaver Ku Timeless Isle Faction: Emperor Shaohao – Revered

Censer of Eternal Agony Sacrifice 90% of maximum health to become an Emissary of Ordos. While transformed, you are hostile to all players, and killing players grants Bloody Coins. Can only be used on the Timeless Isle and flags the user for PvP. "Ritualistic sacrifice is a requirement to enter the ranks of the Ordon." Vendor: Speaker Gulan Timeless Isle 1,000 Timeless Coins

Chalice of Secrets Give in to your anger for 10 seconds. While active, the next killing blow made against a player will transform you into a Mogu for 5.5 seconds, preventing any actions from being taken while you gloat. "The rituals for desecrating a fallen opponent are a well-established part of Mogu culture." Drop: Vale of Eternal Blossoms --

Cloud Ring Summon a cloud ring that your pet will jump through. Requires a flying pet. "Fun for your flying pet." Vendor: San Redscale The Jade Forest Faction: Order of the Cloud Serpent – Revered 1,000 Gold
Cremating Torch Cremate the body of a fallen ally. Quest: Choking the Skies Townlong Steppes --

Cursed Swabby Helmet Transform into a Cursed Hozen Swabby, able to breathe underwater and swim 200% faster. "Used to transform lowly swabbies into mindless hozen brutes, able to row the dread ship Vasuviuz." Treasure: Sunken Treasure Timeless Isle --
Essence of the Breeze Unleash a gentle breeze, lightening your steps. This effect only works in Pandaria. Drop: Ai-Ran the Shifting Cloud Vale of Eternal Blossoms --

Eternal Kiln Places an Eternal Kiln that increases the spirits of those nearby by 4 and allows cooking. "Followers of Ordos carry small cauldrons of fire with them for long journeys into the wilderness." Drop: Eternal Kilnmaster Timeless Isle --

Eternal Warrior's Sigil "Restores 15% of health and mana every 1 second for 6 seconds. Any damage taken will remove the frenzy. Can only be used in Pandaria. "Granted to Shek'zeer's elite guard for service to the Empress." Drop: Gar' lok Dread Wastes --

Farwater Conch Allows you to see far into the distance and grants the ability to create small water droplets. "Inscribed with Jinyu runes that allow the user to understand the language of the waves." Drop: Zai the Outcast Kun-Lai Summit --
Flippable Table Unleash your rage by flipping a table forward. Vendor: Nam Ironpaw Valley of the Four Winds 3 Gold 59 Silver
Foxicopter Controller Summon a remote controlled Foxicopter to fly around for 45 seconds. Vendor: Sally Fizzlefury Valley of the Four Winds 1,000 Gold
Gastropod Shell Summon and control Jerry the Snail. Drop: Gastropod Throne of Thunder --
Gin-Ji Knife Set Chop, mince, and julienne a fresh humanoid or beast corpse. Vendor: Gina Mudclaw Valley of the Four Winds Faction: The Tillers – Exalted 250 Gold

source_text: Glorious Standard of the Kirin Tor Offensive Plant your Kirin Tor Offensive banner. Quest: Securing A Future Isle of Thunder --

guide_name: Glorious Standard of the Sunreaver Onslaught
source_text: Glorious Standard of the Sunreaver Onslaught Plant your Sunreaver Onslaught banner. Quest: Life Blood Isle of Thunder --
Gokk' lok's Shell Stand on a piece of Gokk' lok's shell. Moving cancels the effect. Quest: Promises of Gold Dread Wastes --
Hardened Shell Throw a hard shell, dismounting the target. Unusable on target above level 94. "Seems unfair." Drop: Nessos the Oracle Kun-Lai Summit --

Helpful Wikky's Whistle Calls Helpful Wikky, who will forage for you and bring back presents. Can only be used in Pandaria. "Appears to have been heavily chewed on." Drop: Major Nanners Vale of Eternal Blossoms --
Hozen Beach Ball Get ready for fun in the sun! Drop: Ik-Ik the Nimble Dread Wastes --
Hozen Idol Focus your gaze intently on the target critter, causing it to explode from the pressure after several seconds. Quest: A Monkey Idol Kun-Lai Summit --
Jin Warmkeg's Brew Summon Jin Warmkeg's Brew, which allies can use to have a drink of his ale. Quest: Holed Up Kun-Lai Summit --

Kang's Bindstone Become infused with stone, granting a chance upon killing an opponent to encase them in stone. "Mogu stonebinders use these rune-etched catalysts to transform flesh to stone." Drop: Kang the Soul Thief Vale of Eternal Blossoms --
Ken-Ken's Mask Put Ken-Ken's Mask on a friendly target. Quest: Zhu's Despair Krasarang Wilds --

Kirin Tor Beacon Returns you to the Kirin Tor on the Isle of Thunder. This beacon only works on the Isle of Thunder or in the Throne of Thunder. Alliance Only Quest: The Storm Gathers Townlong Steppes --
Lao Chin's Last Mug A strong alcoholic beverage. Quest: Do a Barrel Roll! Kun-Lai Summit --
Mr. Smite's Brass Compass Release the memories of a long-lost first mate. Drop: Yorik Sharpeye Vale of Eternal Blossoms --
Nat's Fishing Chair Set up a comfy fishing chair. "It even has a beverage holder!" Achievement: Learning from the Best (Fishing) -- --

Odd Polished Stone Become infused with stone, granting a chance upon killing an opponent to encase them in stone. "A stone from a time long past, polished to a shine from eons of erosion." Drop: Eroded Cliffdweller Timeless Isle --
Pandaren Firework Launcher Set up a dazzling firework display. "Party over here!" Drop: Ahone the Wanderer Kun-Lai Summit --
Pandaren Scarecrow Plant your Pandaren Scarecrow. "It certainly looks scary to me." Vendor: Gina Mudclaw Valley of the Four Winds Faction: The Tillers – Revered 250 Gold
Panflute of Pandaria Play the panflute, causing nearby critters to follow you for 15 minutes. Drop: Moldo One-Eye Vale of Eternal Blossoms --
Portable Yak Wash Perform an emergency yak wash in the field. Vendor: Mistweaver Xia Timeless Isle 500 Timewarped Badges
Puntable Marmot Summons a Puntable Marmot at target location. Quest: Rampaging Rodents Valley of the Four Winds --

guide_name: Rime of the Time Lost Mariner
source_text: Rime of the Time Lost Mariner Sing the haunting melody of the crew lost on the Dread Ship Vazuvius. Drop: Dread Ship Vazuvius Timeless Isle --
Ruthers' Harness Summon Ruthers, the bad yak. Quest: Pick a Yak Townlong Steppes --

Salyin Battle Banner Blend into the shadows for 1 second and summon a Salyin Warscout. The Warscout will draw the attention of nearby monsters and run into the distance. Only effective in Pandaria. "Stained with the blood of many unlucky adventurers." Drop: Salyin Warscout Valley of the Four Winds --
Sen'jin Spirit Drum Summon a set of three spirit drums that anyone can play. Vendor: Ravika Echo Isles 10 Gold

Shado-Pan Geyser Gun Unload a torrent of water on allies and enemies with the Geyser Gun. Achievement: Tortos Hidden Geyser Achievement Throne of Thunder Must obtain 250 stacks of Spray Water from the geyser before Tortos.
Shard of Archstone Transform into a Mogu Statue, becoming untargetable for 5 minutes. "A fragment of unknown origin, seething with ancient power." Drop: Havak Kun-Lai Summit --
Shushen's Spittoon Summons Shushen's Spittoon on the ground at target location for 1 minute. Allies can click on the Spittoon to use it. Quest: Raid Leader Slovan Krasarang Wilds --
Silversage Incense Summon a burning stick of Silversage Incense at target location for 20 seconds. Quest: Roadside Assistance Kun-Lai Summit --

Stackable Stag Summon a Stackable Stag at the target location. If there is another Stackable Stag nearby, your Stackable Stag will stack on top of it. Vendor: Sally Fizzlefury Valley of the Four Winds 1,000 Gold

Sunreaver Beacon Returns you to the Sunreavers on the Isle of Thunder. This beacon only works on the Isle of Thunder or in the Throne of Thunder. Horde Only Quest: The Storm Gathers Townlong Steppes --
The Golden Banana Throw the Golden Banana. "Solid gold, and obscenely heavy." Quest: Buried Hozen Treasure Krasarang Wilds --
Totem of Harmony Summon a Totem of Harmony at the target location, illuminating the area for 1 minute. Quest: Hatred Becomes Us Townlong Steppes --
Turnip Paint "Gun" Throw a ball of orange paint at your current friendly target, turning them orange for 6 seconds. Quest: Yellow and Red make Orange Valley of the Four Winds --

Turnip Punching Bag Summon a Turnip Punching Bag at target location for 5 minutes. The punching bag acts as a target dummy while it persists. Only usable outdoors "A turnip with an extremely tough exterior, it can take hits just as well as a heroic level dungeon boss." Quest: Leaders Among Breeders Valley of the Four Winds --

Warning Sign Place a Warning Sign that lasts for 1 minute. A message can be carved into the sign, causing it to last for 1 hour and making it visible to other players. Drop: Jakur of Ordon Timeless Isle --
